visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Idle v1 and death v1 are clean. Attack v1, ranged v1 and cast v1 fired muzzle flashes and sparks, so the retakes say nothing leaves the fist or crossbow and are guided through more painted poses: attack v2 drops one glowing smear frame of the punch (34); ranged v2 skips the shot flash (45-49) and keeps the kick; cast v3 raises the fist cleanly. Hit v1 threw a rod off the crossbow; hit v3 is used up to frame 24, before a bolt drops away. Defend v1 is used up to frame 47, before rejected plates and a flash. The walk keeps the published clip.
